using namespace std;

using i64 = long long;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int add_mod(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
    return a;
}

int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
    return (i64)a * b % MOD;
}

int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = mul_mod(result, base);
        base = mul_mod(base, base);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int discrete_log_table[1000001];

int baby_step_giant_step(int a, int m) {
    memset(discrete_log_table, -1, sizeof(discrete_log_table));
    int s = static_cast<int>(sqrt(m));
    int current = 1;
    int inverse_a = mod_pow(a, m - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= s; ++i) {
        if (discrete_log_table[current] == -1) {
            discrete_log_table[current] = i;
        }
        current = mul_mod(current, inverse_a);
        if (current == 1) {
            return i + 1;
        }
    }
    
    int step = mod_pow(a, s);
    current = step;
    for (int i = 1; i <= s; ++i) {
        if (discrete_log_table[current] != -1) {
            return s * i + discrete_log_table[current];
        }
        current = mul_mod(current, step);
    }
    
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p);
    } else if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1);
    } else {
        int log_val = baby_step_giant_step(k, p);
        int exponent = (p - 1) / log_val;
        cout << mod_pow(p, exponent);
    }
    
    return 0;
}

    x += y;
    return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x;
}

inline int multiply(int x, int y) {
    return static_cast<ll>(x) * y % MOD;
}

int modular_exponentiation(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) result = multiply(result, base);
        base = multiply(base, base);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int log_table[1000001];

int solve_bsgs(int a, int modulus) {
    fill(log_table, log_table + 1000001, -1);
    int block_size = static_cast<int>(sqrt(modulus));
    int current = 1;
    int inv_a = modular_exponentiation(a, modulus - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= block_size; ++i) {
        if (log_table[current] == -1) log_table[current] = i;
        current = multiply(current, inv_a);
        if (current == 1) return i + 1;
    }
    
    int giant_step = modular_exponentiation(a, block_size);
    current = giant_step;
    for (int j = 1; j <= block_size; ++j) {

            return block_size * j + log_table[current];
        }
        current = multiply(current, giant_step);
    }
    
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
